items.title: AutoJack – A Single Web Page Can Hijack Your AI Agent to Execute Malicious Code
items.description: A critical exploit chain dubbed AutoJack that allows a single malicious web page to hijack Microsoft’s AutoGen Studio browsing agent and execute arbitrary code on the host machine without any user interaction beyond submitting a URL. AutoJack is a three-vulnerability exploit chain targeting AutoGen Studio, Microsoft Research’s open-source prototyping UI for multi-agent AI systems. The […] The…
